description: Patient-experience survey results (OAS CAHPS, the Outpatient and Ambulatory Surgery survey) by facility, from the CMS Provider Data Catalog: one row per facility with the survey response rate (percent), the number of completed surveys and the facilities-and-staff composite score, for hospital outpatient departments ("hopd", default) or ambulatory surgical centers ("asc"). Filter by state (two-letter code) and/or facility_id, optionally min_response_rate. Every answer states the reporting period the dataset itself holds (currently a single calendar year) and its release date; if you pass period_start/period_end that the dataset does not hold, no facilities are returned for it and the held period is named instead (set answer_with_held_period=true to get the held-period rows anyway). Facility level only.

answer_with_held_period.description: When the asked period is not held: true returns the rows for the held period (labelled), default false returns none.

facility_id.description: CMS facility id (CCN for hospitals, e.g. "200001"; ASC ids look like "01C0001000").

facility_type.description: "hopd" hospital outpatient departments (default) or "asc" ambulatory surgical centers.

limit.description: Max facilities returned (default 100, max 500). Sorted by response rate, highest first.

min_response_rate.description: Keep only facilities whose survey response rate is at or above this percent, e.g. 35. Facilities with no published rate are excluded and counted.

period_end.description: Optional reporting period end the caller wants, e.g. "2024-09-30".

period_start.description: Optional reporting period start the caller wants, e.g. "2023-10-01" or "10/01/2023". If the dataset does not hold that period the answer says which period it holds.

state.description: Two-letter state code, e.g. "ME". Required unless facility_id is given.

name: cms_oas_cahps_facilities
title: Cms Oas Cahps Facilities
